findings.finding: Communication skills encompass more than professional qualifications.

findings.finding: Using concise messages can enhance communication effectiveness.

findings.finding: Prompting AI with specific queries can improve communication skills.

findings.finding: Leading questions may hinder meaningful client interactions in sales.

findings.finding: Engagement involves mentally stimulating the audience rather than direct pitching.
